messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — we need a cross-project GPU quota bump for an A/B inference run next week. Two projects: `redwood-prod-ml` (prod-sim) and `redwood-experiments-ml` (canary). Target regions: `us-west1` (H100) and `europe-west4` (A100).

Requesting:
- redwood-prod-ml @ us-west1: +8 H100 (for steady baseline pool)
- redwood-experiments-ml @ us-west1: +4 H100 (canary)
- redwood-experiments-ml @ europe-west4: +12 A100 (batch evals)
- also need increase in external EIPs quota in us-west1 by 10 (we provision static egress for dedicated pools)

Rationale: short 10-day burst for latency/cost experiments before committing to Dedicated capacity. Will run continuous batching and KV-cache tests. Estimated spend ~ $55k over 10 days (we have credits) — billing account `BA-9876`. Can someone advise on the fastest path for approvals and whether we should split into multiple support cases?

marta: Do we have billing enabled on both projects and org-level quota pre-approvals? I can help with justification text but we should avoid a huge single case — GCP sometimes splits by region. Also tag the request as `high-throughput-inference` and include the perf spreadsheet.

kevin: +1 to splitting. Also consider requesting spot-preemption capacity first (spot H100/A100) and then fallback to on-demand if we see instability. For europe-west4, L4s might be cheaper for some of the evals — can you outline which jobs need H100 vs A100 vs L4?

sanjay: Good call. Job breakdown:
- realtime baseline (low latency): H100 (us-west1) — 8 persistent instances
- canary routing (low traffic): H100 (us-west1) — 4 spot instances
- large evals (throughput, model distillation): A100 (europe-west4) — 12 preemptible
- lightweight probing/QA: L4 (any region) — not included in primary request, but will ask for 10 L4 as optional.

infra-bot: support-case created: #INC-2026 — GCP quota increase request submitted to Google support. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/INC-2026

cloud-provisioning: Quick checklist: make sure the service account `sa-gpu-provision@redwood-prod-ml.iam.gserviceaccount.com` has `serviceusage.quotaAdmin` and that billing is on. Use the Support Console -> Quotas -> Create Case -> select "Quota Increase" -> include exact project IDs, regions, SKU names (e.g., "NVIDIA A100 (40GB)", "NVIDIA H100 (80GB)"). Paste this snippet to check current quotas:

```
# check GPUs in project
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --format="json(quotas)" | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric|match("NVIDIA"))'
```
Also, include peak QPS and token/sec for justification. If you need me to file it I can do so but I need confirmed numbers.

oncall: Also confirm VPC peering + egress routes — europe-west4 exports require egress quotas and NAT IPs. If you plan to use static EIPs in us-west1 make sure to request a quota increase for "Static Public IPv4 Addresses" for the project.

kevin: For approvals: cc @infra-approvals and include cost center and commit owner. If we plan to flip traffic to Dedicated after tests, state that as follow-up to reduce friction.

sanjay: I'll split into two cases: one for us-west1 (H100 + EIPs) and one for europe-west4 (A100). I'll attach perf spreadsheets and expected ramp schedule (start Mon 09:00 PDT, ramp to full by Tue). I'll post the support case IDs here once created. Thanks! :thumbsup:

infra-bot: support-case updated: #INC-2026 -> added attachments (perf spreadsheet)

sanjay: Support cases opened: #INC-2026 (us-west1 H100 + EIPs) and #INC-2027 (europe-west4 A100). ETA from Google: 24-48h for initial review.
